chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man is free and his wife is a bondwoman, then her divorce is two pronouncements. And if the man is a slave and she is a free woman, then her divorce is three pronouncements.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the number of divorce pronouncements when one spouse is free and the other is a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the number of divorce pronouncements in marriages involving differences of legal status between spouses. It states that the ruling varies depending on whether the husband is free or a slave, making it part of family law discussions on divorce.
